theme: kv config load BEFORE/AFTER + STR template plate

tests.name: positive_kv_parse
tests.note: keys_ok=5; note preserves nested '='; max_jobs=4 via STR in plate; unfilled=0

tests.name: missing_soft_defaults
tests.note: READ OR miss + CLEAR_ERR; defaults role=worker max_jobs=1

weaknesses.title: NOTE form clobbers program var NOTE
weaknesses.detail: NOTE breadcrumb writes the NOTE string var. Storing config in LET NOTE = val then later NOTE "unknown key" overwrites config silently. Plate showed note=unknown key until renamed CFG_NOTE. Same class risk for other dual-purpose names (LAST, OK, STATUS).
weaknesses.repro: LET NOTE = "hello"; NOTE "x"; PRINT_JSON NOTE → breadcrumb text, not hello.

weaknesses.title: No dynamic LET from key string — hardcoded key map only
weaknesses.detail: Cannot LET $key = val from BEFORE peel. Real kv loaders need a switch of EQS key "role"/"max_jobs"/… for every known key. Unknown keys only counted, not stored. Blocks generic config agents.
weaknesses.repro: Parse arbitrary keys in config.kv — only allowlisted keys bind to vars.

weaknesses.title: BEFORE miss keeps whole line as key (LAST_N=0 only signal)
weaknesses.detail: SYS BEFORE "noequals" "=" → LAST="noequals" LAST_N=0. Agents that forget to check found flag treat garbage as keys. AFTER miss → empty string.
weaknesses.repro: SYS BEFORE noequals = ; without IF found==0 CONTINUE.

weaknesses.title: SYS TRIM and LPAD exist but missing from forms/search
weaknesses.detail: TRIM used successfully for key/val whitespace; forms TRIM and search TRIM return n=0. Same for LPAD. Agents may shell out for strip/pad.
weaknesses.repro: ./out/cubalc forms TRIM; search TRIM → empty while SYS TRIM works.

weaknesses.title: GREPV # drops any line containing hash, not only full-line comments
weaknesses.detail: Comment filter SYS GREPV "#" removes values that contain #. No full-line-only comment form.
weaknesses.repro: note=use #tag in config → line dropped by GREPV #.

workarounds: Never name application vars NOTE/LAST/OK; use CFG_NOTE etc.
Hardcode known-key EQS branches; document allowlist
Always check BEFORE/AFTER LAST_N (found) before accepting peel
Use SYS TRIM despite missing catalog entry
Prefer leading-# only: GREPV after ensuring values avoid # or strip comments with STARTS
language_gaps: Map/dict or dynamic var bind from string key
Reserve NOTE breadcrumb under different slot than user NOTE var (or NOTE_MSG)
